invariant: An independent conversational turn never mutates or interrupts the active evaluation run.
A goal change creates a new revision, invalidates the dependency closure, and reuses only complete unaffected outputs.
Pause interrupts at a safe checkpoint boundary and resume continues the same run identity and revision.
Cancel terminates the live task and wins over a late success.
Failed, synthetic, fallback, or source-less public tool output is never accepted as candidate evidence.
A public candidate lookup is bound to a URL, handle, owner, or repository declared in the resume.
The Agent loop enforces normalized de-duplication, retrieval-query budget, and total tool-call budget independently.
A malformed model response cannot amplify runtime work, trace volume, or context with an unbounded batch of proposed tool calls.
Only a callback matching conversation, workflow run, revision, and writable status may update visible state.
Every trace event carries stable run identity, and every tool event carries call identity, status, and input hash.
Production evaluation never replaces model-backed specialist assessment or final reporting with keyword formulas or fixed scores.
Dynamic routing may prune an initial run, but cannot prune optional evaluators that the current revision invalidation closure requires.
A user-supplied or changed job description is a first-class JD source and invalidates JD matching plus all dependent evaluation nodes.
A report produced with a deterministic fallback after an LLM subcall failure is surfaced as PARTIAL_SUCCESS, never SUCCESS.
